core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mansuri is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Of Mansur; belonging to Mansur”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mansuri corresponds to the Arabic form منصوري (Nisba of مَنْصُور; مَنْصُورِيّ (Manṣūriyy)). Its core sense is mansuri; of mansur, belonging to mansur. Mansuri is Arabic مَنْصُورِيّ (Manṣūriyy), the nisba of مَنْصُور (Manṣūr), meaning 'of Mansur; belonging to Mansur'. The source gloss 'Victorious, Successful' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as mansoor, mansour and mansur.
